needsPatrick.item: The next two demo screens ("type a goal, get a campaign" and "photo or spreadsheet to patient list") need AI. Real AI means a paid Anthropic API account (pay per use) and a small server. Use real AI now, or labelled sample drafts first?
needsPatrick.recommendation: Sample drafts first, clearly labelled, at no cost. The spreadsheet import works for real without AI. Get the API account once one clinic says yes. The demo link is private: share it from its Share menu if anyone else should open it

needsPatrick.item: Create a Semaphore account and share an API key
needsPatrick.recommendation: Prepaid credits only; no real sends until the pilot clinic approves

needsPatrick.item: Book 3 dental or vet clinic meetings for the prototype demo
needsPatrick.recommendation: Target the week after the prototype ships

needsPatrick.item: Register the business (DTI) and send one email to DTI Pampanga on free events and announcements

Legal check: dental testimonials, texting a family number about a dependent (DPA s.13), keeping an opt-out after an erasure request, showing a clinic name that names a treatment ("Smile Implant Center") in texts, and whether the frozen sensitive word list is enough (names like Lasik or Thyroid still pass)
needsPatrick.recommendation: One consult covers all five. Until then: testimonials off for dental, texts about dependents name nothing (not even cleaning or check-up, nor a clinic name that names a treatment), erased opt-outs are kept, a treatment-naming clinic name goes out only after the clinic confirms it and only in texts about the patient or their pet, and the word list stays frozen
Revisit is a placeholder. Pick a global, non-Filipino brand before the first clinic demo; Claude can shortlist names with free .com domains
